newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar opens flat on quiet overseas trade.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar opens flat on quiet overseas trade.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar opened flat at C$1.3965 (US$0.7160) in thin trading on Thursday after a quiet overnight session on overseas markets, traders said.
* They said they expected the currency to trade in a neutral range with corporate interests showing some interest to sell U.S. dollars past the C$1.4000 (US$0.7142) level.
The Canadian dollar opened flat at C$1.3965 (US$0.7160) in thin trading on Thursday after a quiet overnight session on overseas markets, traders said.
They said they expected the currency to trade in a neutral range with corporate interests showing some interest to sell U.S. dollars past the C$1.4000 (US$0.7142) level.

"It's a holiday in Europe and there's an election in Britain, so they're a little bit distracted," said one trader. "The trouble with a day like this is that if something does happen, it could be quite significant just because of the lack of liquidity in the market."
The Canada dollar was tested early this morning when one seller came into the market and pushed the unit to C$1.3960 (US$0.7163), the trader said.
With Europe removed as a market player today, analysts said they were waiting for key U.S. payrolls data due out on Friday to determine the short-term direction of the Canada dollar.

The U.S. government is expected to report jobless claims for the week ended April 26 and payrolls for April. Both are expected to provide a clue on the inflationary pressure in the U.S. economy and the likelihood of rate rises.
Non-farm payrolls were seen rising 211,000 in April while the unemployment rate was seen unchanged at 5.2 percent.
The U.S. economy seems to be growing but not at a runaway pace, said Reid Farrill, corporate foreign exchange adviser for CIBC Wood Gundy. "I like the Canada dollar right now."
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar dipped to 1.2370 marks from 1.2379 on Wednesday and jumped to 90.99 yen from Wednesday's 90.80 yen.
